rules.description: Claimant or partner must receive a qualifying benefit
rules.reason_if_failed: You or your partner must receive Universal Credit, Income Support, income-based Jobseeker's Allowance, income-related Employment and Support Allowance, Pension Credit, Housing Benefit, or a Support for Mortgage Interest loan

rules.description: Must claim within 6 months of the funeral
rules.reason_if_failed: You must apply within 6 months of the funeral. Your claim is now out of time.

rules.description: Funeral must be in the UK, EEA, or Switzerland
rules.reason_if_failed: Funeral Expenses Payment only covers funerals arranged in the UK, the European Economic Area (EEA), or Switzerland

rules.description: Must have eligible relationship with deceased
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be the partner of the deceased, parent of a stillborn baby after 24 weeks, parent of a deceased child under 16 (or under 20 in approved education), or a close relative/friend where the partner cannot claim

rules.description: Must have invoice or signed contract from funeral director
rules.reason_if_failed: You need an invoice or signed contract from the funeral director. Estimates are not accepted.

edge_cases.description: Deceased had a pre-paid funeral plan
edge_cases.action: Payment limited to £120 for items not covered by the plan. Assessment must verify plan coverage.

edge_cases.description: Close relative of deceased is in work or not on qualifying benefit
edge_cases.action: May not be eligible for payment. Requires manual assessment of family circumstances.

edge_cases.description: Claimant is waiting for decision on qualifying benefit
edge_cases.action: Allow claim to proceed. Payment decision will be made once benefit claim is decided.
Decision on claim will not be made until after next Universal Credit payment.

edge_cases.description: Deceased has estate with sufficient funds
edge_cases.action: Payment will be deducted from any money received from the estate (excluding house or personal effects left to surviving spouse/civil partner).

edge_cases.description: Partner of deceased exists but cannot claim (e.g. in prison, abroad)
edge_cases.action: Close relative or friend may be eligible. Verify partner's circumstances and reason for inability to claim.
